stages.instruction: Before subject work agree coarse phases of this planning Task with the independent reviewer. Preserve actual Sprint requirements, constraints and assumptions; design only imminent composition/classification: goal, required result, acceptance criteria, one primary outcome per Task, necessary boundaries/coverage and supported sources. Do not design all future Task stages, tests/classes/commands or prototypes.
